paras: Smith's blind skink (Dibamus smithi) is a species of legless lizard in the family Dibamidae. The species is endemic to Vietnam.
The specific name, smithi, is in honor of British herpetologist Malcolm Arthur Smith.
Dibamus smithi is endemic to central Vietnam.
The preferred natural habitat of Dibamus smithi is forest, at altitudes of 1,212–1,515 m (3,976–4,970 ft).
Dibamus smithi is terrestrial and fossorial.
